blind.description: A wooden merchant table with carved trestle legs, draped with a red fringed tablecloth. Displayed on top are various apothecary goods: green glass flasks and bottles with cork stoppers (one resting in a wooden slat casing), two white ceramic jars with lidded tops and yellow accent bands, small amber/brown medicine bottles, bundles of dried green herbs, and a grey stone mortar with pestle. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with clean materials and no floating elements.
blind.from_above: A red rectangular tabletop crowded with circular containers including two white jar lids with round knobs, several round green and amber bottle tops with corks, a grey circular mortar with a diagonally resting pestle, and textured clusters of green herbs near the edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: The table surface is about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.8 ft tall to the tops of the bottles), with a table length of about 4.5 ft.
